card.name: Journal name before volume number
card.fires_on: The space or punctuation right after a journal name or PMID label in a reference list, just before the volume, year or ID number.

modes.label: After journal name
modes.description: The space following an abbreviated journal title, where the volume number comes next.

modes.label: After PMID or date
modes.description: A colon, semicolon or space after PMID or a publication date, before the number.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a citation where the journal's volume or ID number is about to appear.
